description: How to turn business needs into a justified cloud design: sizing, availability, disaster recovery, cost, service levels, migration and governance. Students sketch architectures, size and price them in the cloud console, and defend them in costed design reviews.
modelledOn: Well-Architected Framework guidance from the major cloud providers
Bass, Clements and Kazman, Software Architecture in Practice
Cloud architect and solutions architect associate certification syllabi
outcomes: Translate business requirements into measurable quality-attribute scenarios and size a workload from its demand profile.
Select compute, storage, database and network services for a workload and justify each choice against the well-architected pillars.
Calculate composite availability and design a multi-zone and disaster-recovery solution that meets stated RPO and RTO targets.
Build and compare cost models using on-demand, committed and spot pricing, including data transfer and operational costs.
Plan a migration and landing zone for an existing system and present a costed architecture proposal in a design review.

units.title: Architecture foundations and well-architected pillars
topics: The architect role: stakeholders, concerns, views and architecture decision records
Reference architectures: three-tier web application, static site plus API, event-driven pipeline, data lake
Well-architected pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimisation, sustainability
Quality attributes and trade-offs: utility trees and scenario-based evaluation
Shared responsibility model across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and serverless

units.title: Requirements and workload sizing
topics: Functional and non-functional requirements captured as measurable scenarios
Workload characterisation: request rate, peak-to-average ratio, data growth, read/write mix
Capacity estimation: Little's law and back-of-envelope sizing of vCPU, memory, IOPS and bandwidth
Demand forecasting for a mobile-money or e-commerce workload with seasonal peaks
Constraints: data residency under the Ghana Data Protection Act, user latency, intermittent connectivity
Choosing service models: virtual machine, container, serverless and managed database

units.title: Compute, storage, network and data design patterns
topics: Compute patterns: stateless web tier, autoscaling groups, containers versus functions
Storage choices: object, block and file; storage classes and lifecycle policies
Database selection: relational, key-value and document stores; caching tiers, read replicas and sharding
Network design: virtual networks, subnets, routing, NAT, layer-4 versus layer-7 load balancers, CDN
Asynchronous decoupling with queues, topics and event buses
Identity and access design: least privilege, roles, federation and service identities

units.title: Availability, regions and disaster recovery
topics: Failure domains: instance, rack, availability zone and region; correlated failures
Designing for high availability: redundancy, health checks, failover, multi-zone active-active
Availability arithmetic: serial and parallel components, nines and composite availability
Disaster recovery strategies: backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, multi-site
RPO and RTO derived from business impact; backup testing and runbooks
Failure injection and game days for validating a design

units.title: Cost modelling and pricing models
topics: Pricing models: on-demand, reserved and committed use, spot, free tiers, per-request billing
Total cost of ownership versus on-premises; capital versus operating expenditure
Data egress, inter-region transfer and other hidden costs
Cost allocation: tagging, budgets, showback and unit economics such as cost per transaction
Right-sizing and the FinOps cycle of inform, optimise and operate

units.title: Service levels: SLIs, SLOs and SLAs
topics: Service level indicators, objectives and agreements; choosing indicators for latency, availability and correctness
Error budgets and burn-rate alerting
Reading provider SLAs: service credits, exclusions and measurement windows
Observability design: metrics, logs, traces and alert thresholds
Load and performance testing against an SLO

units.title: Migration strategies and landing zones
topics: The migration strategies: rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, retire and retain
Discovery and dependency mapping; planning migration waves
Landing zone design: account structure, guardrails, hub-and-spoke network and central logging
Data migration: online transfer versus offline appliances, cut-over and rollback plans
Hybrid connectivity: site-to-site VPN, dedicated links and DNS design
Cloud adoption: skills, operating model and a cloud centre of excellence

units.title: Security, compliance and governance by design
topics: Threat modelling a cloud architecture with STRIDE
Encryption at rest and in transit; key management and rotation
Policy as code, organisation-level guardrails and compliance baselines
Multi-tenancy and isolation; sustainability and carbon-aware region choice

units.title: Architecture proposals and design reviews
topics: Structuring a proposal: context, options considered, decision, risks and costs
Architecture diagrams that communicate: context, container and deployment views
Running a design review: checklists, risk register and scoring rubric
Presenting a costed recommendation to non-technical decision makers

schedule.title: Architects, pillars and reference architectures
schedule.exercise: Read a short case about a Ghanaian online retailer, list its stakeholders and concerns, and write two architecture decision records that trade off cost against reliability.

tasks.title: Draw a three-tier web application reference architecture for a school fee portal and label each tier with a cloud service category
Review a short case in the scenario engine and score the proposed design against each of the six well-architected pillars with written evidence
Build a utility tree for a mobile-money platform, rank scenarios by importance and risk, and decide which design choice each scenario drives

schedule.title: Requirements and demand profiles
schedule.exercise: Convert a vague brief for a ride-hailing app into ten measurable scenarios, then estimate peak requests per second from daily users and a peak-to-average ratio.

tasks.title: Rewrite five vague requirements from a case brief as measurable scenarios with a stimulus, response and response measure
Use Little's law to size concurrent sessions and vCPUs for a service with a given arrival rate, response time and per-request CPU cost
Write a script that generates a week of request traffic with daily and weekly seasonality and reports the peak-to-average ratio and the p99 load

schedule.title: Forecasting, constraints and service models
schedule.exercise: Forecast three years of growth for a mobile-money workload, list the legal and latency constraints, and choose between VM, container and serverless with reasons.

tasks.title: Deploy the same small web API as a virtual machine and as a serverless function in the console and compare setup effort and idle cost
Fit a growth curve to twelve months of transaction counts, forecast three years ahead and compute the storage and bandwidth needed at each year end
Work a branching case on data residency and latency, choosing regions and replication for a health records workload and scoring each decision against a rubric

schedule.title: Compute, storage and database choices
schedule.exercise: Pick compute, storage class and database for four workloads (image upload, ledger, session cache, analytics) and justify each in one paragraph.

tasks.title: Create an object storage bucket, upload sample files and add a lifecycle rule moving objects to a cheaper class after thirty days
Configure an autoscaling group behind a load balancer with a CPU target and show scale-out under a generated load spike
Compare a relational schema with a key-value layout for an order service, run the same read and write mix, and recommend one with measured evidence

schedule.title: Networks, decoupling and identity
schedule.exercise: Design a virtual network with public and private subnets for a three-tier application and define least-privilege roles for each tier.

tasks.title: Build a virtual network with one public and one private subnet, place a web server and a database, and verify which can reach the internet
Insert a queue between an order API and a worker function, then show that a worker outage does not lose orders
Audit a given over-permissive IAM policy set, replace it with least-privilege roles per service, and prove access is denied for forbidden actions

schedule.title: Failure domains and availability arithmetic
schedule.exercise: Compute the composite availability of a design with a load balancer, two web servers and a database, then redesign it to reach 99.95 percent.

tasks.title: Compute the availability of two serial and two parallel component chains using given component availabilities and convert each result to yearly downtime
Place web servers in two zones behind a load balancer, fail one zone in the console and measure the failover time
Map the failure domains of a given architecture, identify every single point of failure and redraw it to survive the loss of a whole zone

schedule.title: Disaster recovery and failure injection
schedule.exercise: For a bank branch app with stated RPO and RTO, choose a disaster recovery strategy, estimate its cost and write the recovery runbook.

tasks.title: Derive RPO and RTO for three business services from a stated cost of downtime per hour and select a suitable recovery tier for each
Implement a pilot-light recovery: replicate a database to a second region, then promote it and redirect traffic after a simulated region loss
Run a game day: inject instance, zone and dependency failures into a deployed design, record the impact on the SLO and fix the weakest link

schedule.title: Cost models and pricing
schedule.exercise: Build a spreadsheet-style cost model of a workload under three pricing models and report where egress and storage surprise the budget.

tasks.title: Use the pricing calculator to price a fixed workload on demand, with a one-year commitment and on spot capacity, and rank the three totals
Model a media-serving workload including egress and inter-region replication and identify which line item dominates the monthly bill
Compute a five-year total cost of ownership for an on-premises server room versus a cloud design with net present value and a break-even point

schedule.title: Service levels and observability
schedule.exercise: Define three SLIs and SLOs for a payment API, compute the monthly error budget and write alert rules based on burn rate.

tasks.title: Choose suitable SLIs and SLO targets for an online booking service from a list of candidate metrics and justify each
Compute the monthly error budget for a 99.9 percent SLO, plot budget consumption across a given incident log and flag the burn-rate alert times
Compare two provider SLAs for the same service, compute expected service credits for a given outage history and decide whether the SLA matches the business need

schedule.title: Migration strategy and landing zones
schedule.exercise: Classify the ten applications of a ministry data centre into the migration strategies and sketch the landing zone that will receive them.

tasks.title: Classify eight applications into rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, retire or retain using the facts in a given inventory
Draw the dependency map of a given application estate and group the applications into three migration waves with reasons
Create a landing zone with separate accounts, central logging, network hub-and-spoke and a guardrail policy, then show a violating deployment being blocked

schedule.title: Data migration, hybrid links and adoption
schedule.exercise: Write a cut-over plan with rollback for moving a 20 TB database to the cloud over a limited link, including the connectivity choice.

tasks.title: Calculate transfer time for a 20 TB dataset over a 100 Mbps link and compare it to an offline transfer appliance schedule
Set up a site-to-site VPN between an on-premises network and a cloud virtual network and verify private name resolution across it
Work a branching cut-over case where replication lags, deciding go, delay or rollback at each step, scored on data loss and downtime

schedule.title: Security, policy and sustainability by design
schedule.exercise: Threat-model a cloud payment architecture with STRIDE and propose controls for the three highest risks.

tasks.title: Enable encryption at rest on a bucket and a volume with a customer-managed key and show access fails after the key is disabled
Annotate a data flow diagram of a web application with trust boundaries and list one STRIDE threat for each boundary crossing
Write organisation-level guardrail policies that deny public buckets and unapproved regions, then test them against a set of compliant and non-compliant deployments

schedule.title: Proposals, reviews and capstone
schedule.exercise: Prepare and defend a costed architecture proposal for a regional agricultural marketplace in a mock design review with a rubric.

tasks.title: Draw a context, container and deployment diagram for a given system, with every arrow labelled by protocol and purpose
Review a classmate-style proposal in the scenario engine using the checklist, record risks in a register and score it against the rubric
Deploy a proposed architecture in the console, load-test it, and present the measured availability, latency and monthly cost against the proposal targets
